feature: Deck notices — the Notices sheet and the header's tag (PR 6)
note: One deck at both widths, photographed with the notice fixture standing: run `PROBE_KEEP=1 pnpm probe:notices-sheet` first, which leaves the fixture deck (d0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000beef) holding a banned card and an unread Game Changer entry, with its reading marked dirty. The next run of that probe puts it all back.
